Worktree Setup

Create a dedicated git worktree for this task, isolated from the main checkout and any other in-flight work. Return the worktree path and the plan unchanged so the following tasks can act on it.

setup-stack1.4.0 Bring up a local stack scoped to this worktree.

anthropic/claude-sonnet-5

Setup Stack

Bring up a full local stack scoped entirely to this worktree through the setup-stack port. The stack is self-contained and shares nothing with other environments. If it fails it can be retried without recreating the worktree. Return the stack details and the plan.

create-diff3.0.1 Implement the plan against the worktree as a committed diff.

Create Diff

Implement the approved plan against the isolated worktree, producing the change as a diff committed to the task's branch. If this task received test failures as input, correct the diff to address them. Return the diff.

Testing

Validate the diff through four checks in order: compile, unit tests, integration tests, e2e tests. If any check fails, emit fail and return the failures so the diff can be corrected. Only if all four pass, emit pass and return the diff.

Body

Agentic Review

Review the diff for correctness, quality, and adherence to the plan. Catch design problems, missed requirements, and risky changes that the tests do not. Emit pass and return the diff.

Teardown Stack

Tear down the stack through the teardown-stack port: stop its processes, drop its database, and remove its generated config. Return confirmation.

remove-worktree2.0.0 Remove the git worktree, leaving the branch intact.

Remove Worktree

Remove the git worktree. This deletes the working checkout only; the branch and its committed diff remain in the repository. Return confirmation.

# examples/0.1.0/feat-dev-small.yaml from the spec, with its placeholder shas
# set to null so the document validates.
openawf: 0.1.0
name: feat-dev-small
summary: Take an approved plan and run it to a reviewed diff in an isolated worktree, then tear down.
model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
metadata:
  tags: [development, review]
  authors: [OpenAWF]
license: Apache-2.0
version: 0.3.0
external-version: 7c1e4b2a-9d3f-4e6a-b8c0-2f5d1a9e3b47
sha: null

start: worktree-setup
orchestration:
  worktree-setup: setup-stack
  setup-stack: create-diff
  create-diff: testing
  testing:
    pass: agentic-review
    fail:
      task: create-diff
      retries: 2
      session: resume
  agentic-review:
    pass: teardown-stack
  teardown-stack: remove-worktree
  remove-worktree: null

tasks:
  worktree-setup:
    version: 2.2.1
    sha: null
    summary: Create an isolated git worktree for this task.
    input:
      type: object
      properties:
        plan:
          type: string
      required: [plan]
    body: |
      # Worktree Setup

      Create a dedicated git worktree for this task, isolated from the main
      checkout and any other in-flight work. Return the worktree path and the
      plan unchanged so the following tasks can act on it.

  setup-stack:
    version: 1.4.0
    sha: null
    summary: Bring up a local stack scoped to this worktree.
    body: |
      # Setup Stack

      Bring up a full local stack scoped entirely to this worktree through the
      setup-stack port. The stack is self-contained and shares nothing with
      other environments. If it fails it can be retried without recreating the
      worktree. Return the stack details and the plan.

  create-diff:
    version: 3.0.1
    sha: null
    summary: Implement the plan against the worktree as a committed diff.
    body: |
      # Create Diff

      Implement the approved plan against the isolated worktree, producing the
      change as a diff committed to the task's branch. If this task received
      test failures as input, correct the diff to address them. Return the diff.

  testing:
    version: 2.1.0
    sha: null
    summary: Run compile, unit, integration, and e2e checks on the diff.
    outcomes:
      pass:
        type: object
        properties:
          diff: { type: string }
        required: [diff]
      fail:
        type: object
        properties:
          errors: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        required: [errors]
    body: |
      # Testing

      Validate the diff through four checks in order: compile, unit tests,
      integration tests, e2e tests. If any check fails, emit `fail` and return
      the failures so the diff can be corrected. Only if all four pass, emit
      `pass` and return the diff.

  agentic-review:
    version: 1.2.3
    sha: null
    summary: Review the passing diff for correctness and quality.
    model: [anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5]
    system: |
      You are a senior reviewer. Judge the diff against the plan, not your
      own preferences. Never edit the diff yourself.
    outcomes:
      pass:
        type: object
        properties:
          diff: { type: string }
        required: [diff]
    body: |
      # Agentic Review

      Review the diff for correctness, quality, and adherence to the plan.
      Catch design problems, missed requirements, and risky changes that the
      tests do not. Emit `pass` and return the diff.

  teardown-stack:
    version: 1.4.0
    sha: null
    summary: Tear down the stack brought up for this worktree.
    body: |
      # Teardown Stack

      Tear down the stack through the teardown-stack port: stop its processes,
      drop its database, and remove its generated config. Return confirmation.

  remove-worktree:
    version: 2.0.0
    sha: null
    summary: Remove the git worktree, leaving the branch intact.
    body: |
      # Remove Worktree

      Remove the git worktree. This deletes the working checkout only; the
      branch and its committed diff remain in the repository. Return confirmation.
